3. Cut a rectangular pocket into the open top, sized to fit within the interior cavity.
4. Drill a through hole vertically through the part at the center.
5. Drill a second through hole vertically through the part, offset from the center.
6. Drill a third through hole vertically through the part, offset from the center on the opposite side.
7. Apply a fillet of R5.7 to the four vertical edges of the part.
8. Apply a fillet of R5.7 to the two top edges of the part.
9. Apply a fillet of R5.7 to the two bottom edges of the part.
